ask: the rows on the invoices table in proto-clinic are too tight, give them more room
notes: One small vague note. Quick track. A good intake reads 'more room' as a number (for example 4 px to 10 px row padding) and asks one question at most: the Invoices table only, or every table.
message:
## Brief

- **Goal:** the rows on the Invoices table in `proto-clinic` are too tight. Give them more room.
- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html` (Northside Physio). It is the only prototype in the folder and a single plain HTML file, so I will serve it locally with the built-in server and give you the link.
- **Reference:** none, so the copy-reference step is skipped.
- **Design rules:** no `CLAUDE.md` in the folder and no design skill installed. I will use the built-in design check.
- **Where the result goes:** a local link only. Nothing is published, pushed, committed or sent.
- **Start check:** Node v25.9.0 and Chrome are both there, so screenshots and before/after compares will work.
- **Stop fact:** every request below is done and checked on the real page. No other screen (Today, Clients, Settings) changed without a reason. The link opens.

## Request list

| # | Note, in words | Screens | Where | Check | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Invoices table: give the body rows more room. Now each cell has `4px 10px` padding, which makes rows about 29px tall. New: `14px 10px` padding, so rows are about 49px tall. (my reading) | invoices | this place | Measured row height on Invoices is 44px or more. The rule applies only to the Invoices table. The Today and Clients tables are unchanged in the before/after compare. | todo |

Noted in the code: the cell padding comes from one shared `th, td` rule used by all three tables (Today, Clients, Invoices). I will scope the change to the Invoices table, so the other two keep their current spacing.

## Questions

1. **Scope.** Your note names the Invoices table only, so I marked it **this place only**. The Today and Clients tables have the same tight rows. Should they get more room too? Default: **no, Invoices only**.
2. **How much room.** "More room" has two readings: taller rows (more padding above and below), or wider columns (more space between them). I took taller rows, `4px` to `14px` vertical padding, and left the columns alone. Default: **taller rows, 14px**.

Anything missing or wrong in the list? Notes you send later still join this run.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
